title: Flareless Micro CDN Approval Manifest
description: Coordinator side approval record for public content allowed to route through the optional micro CDN path.

approvalId.description: Stable unique identifier for the approval event.

issuer.description: System, maintainer, or authority that issued the approval.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the approval was created.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp after which content must not route.

namespace.description: Public namespace for the content family.

publicPath.description: Public path exposed through /mcdn/{namespace}/{displayPath}. Must not be absolute or contain traversal.

sha256.description: Expected SHA256 digest of the bytes.

contentType.description: Declared media type for the approved asset.

originUrl.description: Public origin URL used as the authoritative source.

signatureAlgorithm.description: Optional signature algorithm label. Use none until real signature verification is implemented.

signature.description: Optional detached signature placeholder for future verification.
